title: Winged Man and Dragon
description: A barefoot man with large blue feathered wings and a glowing halo stands on ancient stone steps, looking back over his shoulder. Beside him, a vibrant purple and orange dragon with golden horns perches on a broken column, surrounded by numerous floating translucent blue and purple spheres.
